1933, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 102 Cont.
Apr. 1 Mary Koska - 15 - 3 weeks sick cold, then nervous break-down, now mentally weak ....
Mrs. Laureta Stonley - 50 - abcesses of intestines - fearfully painful.
Wilfred Lefebure - 33 - Walkerville - poisoned knee - discouraged.
Apr. 1 -Death Fooled? Hope so. 9:15 p.m. weeping Mr. & Mrs. - come to Monastery pleading in tears that I come down to Harper Hospital to bless little Richard Joseph. Same little 3-year-old had operation for mastoid early To-day and had his jugler-vein cut - followed by blood-transfusion. "Hopeless"! he is enrolled in Ser. Mass As- soc'n .... Next morning Apr. 2 out of danger ... !
James Fegan - 16 - mastoid operation .... Edw'd Woods - 31 - lost sight in only eye left him since 10 years ago. This happened about a month ago. His sister enrolled him in S. M. As'n and eye soon improved - still weak ....
Page 103
Apr. 5 Gas-Station - Mr. Jos Forest struggling ... Mrs. asks prayers ... to meet obligations ....
Mrs. L. Farrell - 57 - of Owasso - diabetis
Eliz. Kizinski - young lady Heart & T. B. Beverly & Shirley - Ist cousins -6 yrs. old had measles - now threa- tened with T. B. & lung ....
Mrs. Mael Phan - 53 - Vericose ulcers
Albert Richer - 32 - in bad comp. 3 mo. - now doing better but not yet to confession.
Mary Buschohle - 14 - had infantile paralysis 7 yrs. ago - got well but now St. Vitis dance - arm helpless
Apr. 12 George T. Schaldenbrand - spiritism Vera Kauffman ... about 30 - Ohio Mary Koska - 15 - acts as a possessed Edw'd King - 7 -
